get_a_key.account_routes: GET and POST /v1/account/api-key with the signed-in account's Firebase ID token (what saturday.fit/api calls)
get_a_key.how: A key comes with any paid Saturday plan, member or coach. Sign in at saturday.fit/api to make yours.
get_a_key.limits: 2 requests a second, 200 calls a day
get_a_key.more_athletes: To cover more than 10 athletes, write to api@saturday.fit about what you're building and we'll raise it.
get_a_key.platforms: Building Saturday into a platform for many athletes? Write to api@saturday.fit about a partnership.
get_a_key.trial: Each athlete gets 30 days of exact numbers; after that, exact numbers come with the athlete's Saturday subscription.
get_a_key.who_is_this: Builders whose athletes live in their own system. Coaching athletes who use the Saturday app? The coach portal is your lane, and its API keys come with every paid coach plan: https://coach.saturday.fit
